description: Family comparison table, GO decision table, and composite figure of the three independent N-terminal discriminators
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Comparison table: all discriminators computed in this job (values carried from the
# executed analyses recorded in iterations 1-2; see provenance CSVs for the raw runs).
cmp=pd.DataFrame([
 # gene, acc, UniProt N-term call, ECO, P1 residue implied by SP call, PWM score, P(cleaved SP), dGapp, HPA class, PE
 ["AADACL2","Q6P093","SIGNAL 1..18 (+ Secreted kw)","ECO:0000255","His18",4.36,0.175,-0.977,"Predicted secreted","PE1"],
 ["AADAC","P22760","Signal-anchor type II 5..25","ECO:0000255",  "n/a",-1.20,0.026,-1.539,"Predicted intracellular","PE1"],
 ["NCEH1","Q6PIU2","Signal-anchor type II 8..28","ECO:0000255",  "n/a", 5.17,0.342,-0.900,"Predicted membrane / ER","PE1"],
 ["AADACL3","Q5VUY0","no N-terminal feature","none",             "n/a", 7.42,0.112,-2.696,"Predicted membrane","PE2"],
 ["AADACL4","Q5VUY2","Signal-anchor type II","ECO:0000255",      "n/a", 7.04,0.101,-3.658,"Predicted membrane","PE3"],
],columns=["gene","accession","uniprot_Nterm_call","evidence_code","P1_if_cleaved",
           "SP_PWM_score","P_cleaved_SP_logreg","dGapp_kcal_mol","HPA_protein_class","protein_existence"])
cmp.to_csv("aadac_family_comparison_table.csv",index=False)
print(cmp.to_string(index=False)); print()

go=pd.DataFrame([
 ["GO:0005576","extracellular region","CC","IEA:UniProtKB-SubCell","REMOVE",
  "Derives automatically from SIGNAL 1..18; the predictor behind that call misassigns 60.6% of short-tail type II anchors; no experimental secretion data for AADACL2"],
 ["GO:0016020","membrane","CC","IBA:GO_Central","RETAIN",
  "Consistent with anchor reading and with all four paralogs; keep as the safe parent while the specific compartment is unproven"],
 ["GO:0005789","endoplasmic reticulum membrane","CC","would be ISS/IBA from AADAC+NCEH1","LEAD, do not add yet",
  "Supported by paralogy (51.4% identity to AADAC, IDA ER membrane) and by anchor energetics, but AADACL2 has no direct localization experiment"],
 ["GO:0016021","integral component of membrane","CC","would be ECO:0000255","LEAD",
  "Follows if the SIGNAL feature is converted to a type II signal anchor TRANSMEM feature"],
 ["GO:0106435","carboxylesterase activity / GO:0052689 carboxylic ester hydrolase","MF","IEA:InterPro","RETAIN, non-core until assayed",
  "Catalytic register (Ser-Asp-His) is intact but no substrate has been demonstrated for AADACL2"],
],columns=["GO_ID","term","aspect","current_or_proposed_evidence","recommended_action","rationale"])
go.to_csv("GO_decision_table_AADACL2.csv",index=False)
print(go.to_string(index=False))

# Composite figure of the independently computed discriminators for AADACL2
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,4.2))
a=axes[0]
a.bar(["Ala","Gly","Ser","Cys","Thr","His\n(AADACL2)"],[46.1,25.3,12.0,3.4,2.8,0.14],
      color=["#95a5a6"]*5+["#c0392b"])
a.set_ylabel("% of 740 experimental human signal peptides")
a.set_title("Residue at P1 (the -1 cleavage position)")
a.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8)

a=axes[1]
a.bar(["signal\npeptides\n(n=45)","type II\nanchors\n(n=45)"],[0.37,-1.44],
      yerr=[[0.77,1.14],[0.81,0.42]],color=["#2980b9","#27ae60"],capsize=5,width=.5)
a.axhline(-0.977,color="#c0392b",lw=2)
a.text(1.35,-0.977,"AADACL2\n-0.98",color="#c0392b",va="center",fontsize=9)
a.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6)
a.set_ylabel("$\\Delta G_{app}$ of Sec61 insertion (kcal/mol)")
a.set_title("Membrane insertion energetics\n(median, IQR; AUC 0.924, p=4.2e-12)")

a=axes[2]
g=["AADACL2","AADAC","NCEH1","AADACL3","AADACL4","CES1\n(secreted)","ALB\n(secreted)","DPP4\n(type II)"]
p=[0.175,0.026,0.342,0.112,0.101,0.953,0.829,0.016]
a.barh(range(len(g))[::-1],p,color=["#c0392b"]+["#27ae60"]*4+["#2980b9"]*2+["#27ae60"])
a.set_yticks(range(len(g))[::-1]); a.set_yticklabels(g,fontsize=8)
a.axvline(0.5,ls="--",color="k",lw=.8)
a.set_xlabel("P(cleaved signal peptide), logistic model\n5-fold CV ROC-AUC 0.913")
a.set_title("Classifier trained on 740 SPs vs 401 anchors")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nsaved aadac_family_comparison_table.csv, GO_decision_table_AADACL2.csv")
